name: Flint Shadowmore
label: Quest
description: Flint Shadowmore: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The only information we have thus far, then, is that Nathanos Marris may have been slain by this Blightcaller. We assume the Blightcaller is the same fiend that disposed of my agents.

Flint Shadowmore, another SI:7 operative, is stationed at the Alliance encampment of Chillwind Point in the Western Plaguelands. Seek him out; he will debrief you on the current situation in the Plagues and give you an assignment.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The first mission will be straight up, friend. You go in, you come out. Recon...
